'''Player's Council''' is the YouTube channel of the Player's Council, the volunteer organization that has maintained Decipher's ''The Lord of the Rings'' Trading Card Game since Decipher stopped supporting it. Besides LOTR-TCG tournaments, meetings and development streams (also streamed live on Twitch as playerscouncil), the channel holds the largest archive of Decipher's audio shows, including [[Radio Free Decipher]], and footage from [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="yt-ya9enbotTvk">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ya9enbotTvk Player's Council - July 2020 Goals and Vision], Player's Council (18 January 2021).</ref><ref name="yt-SogYdPiqunQ" /> The channel has about 270 uploads (January 2021 – 2026), of which about 230 concern Decipher's games generally rather than LOTR-TCG play.

== Decipher radio archive ==

From February to May 2022 the channel uploaded the surviving episodes of Decipher's audio shows, recovered from Wayback copies of decipher.com and from the files of former host [[Evan Lorentz]], with an episode index on the LOTR-TCG Player's Council wiki.<ref name="lotrpc-rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher], LOTR-TCG Player's Council wiki.</ref><ref name="yt-w2Ao759YJlk">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w2Ao759YJlk Broadcast 2 - Radio Free Decipher (11 December, 1998): Jerry, Tom, and Chuck Discuss Operatives], Player's Council (19 February 2022). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-w2Ao759YJlk Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="yt-_et6x6X0pto">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_et6x6X0pto Ep. 24 - Decipher WARS Radio (21 January, 2005):  Vegas, Vegas, Vegas], Player's Council (15 May 2022). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-_et6x6X0pto Internet Archive].</ref>
* [[Radio Free Decipher]] (1998–2004): 194 uploads, including the 28 December 2001 Special Broadcast. [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYLMRQ0b_feAbpbNVQwlw3y8XH30ZQS1U Playlist].
* [[WARS Radio|Decipher WARS Radio]] (2004–05): 23 of 24 episodes. [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYLMRQ0b_feBuO2OA_dmg5M8epiXPi8C1 Playlist].
* [[Decipher Games Radio]] (2005): 2 of 4 episodes. [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYLMRQ0b_feBzOqJyvRYxFijARCFqOrgC Playlist].
Copies of these uploads are kept on the Internet Archive.

== SWCCG-related videos ==

The Star Wars CCG [[GEMP]] server descends from the LOTR-TCG GEMP code, and some development streams on the channel cover the SWCCG side. In June 2025 the channel streamed a two-part demonstration of the card test rig newly imported into SWCCG GEMP, used for fixing bugs, testing cards and developing new cards, followed by a stream building unit tests for one card from scratch.<ref name="yt-0pGC1fMww90" /><ref name="yt-uVb1ZXw5BzA" /><ref name="yt-SogYdPiqunQ" />
